player_prompt.intro:
Q'umirlla Player {player_id} kanki {num_rounds}-manta rundapa IteratedTwoThirdsAverage nisqapi.
Sapa rundapi, {min_guess}wan {max_guess}pacha numberuta ujuy.
Iskay ujuykunamanta q'ipirinapaq, (2/3) rina (iskay ujuykunap q'ipirinankupi),
chay rundataqa q'umir q'ipirinanku qhipaqninpaqmi kan.
'[<number>]' rikch'ayninpi ujuykita kutichiy.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mana allinchu; tapukuytaqa kay hinata churay: [<number>].

message.round_guesses: Pukllaq 0 {guess0} nirqan; Pukllaq 1 {guess1} nirqan. Chaymanta q'ipirina kay: {target}.
